snippet.title: Shores of the Fallen - Official Trailer | Open-World Zombie Survival
snippet.description:
The radio stopped repeating on day nine.

Shores of the Fallen is an open-world zombie survival game set on a storm-battered island. The fog rolls in off the water after dark, and the infected come with it. Some of them are slow. Some are not.

Every shot in this trailer is real in-game footage.

- Zombies that hunt by sight and sound. Crouch, stay in the dark, pick your fights.
- Scavenge every house, shop and wreck on the island.
- Hunt, fish from the shore or the boat, and build a base log by log.
- Drive the truck through the hordes. Keep it fuelled.
- Stay out of the water. The sharks don't miss.

Play the FREE demo now: https://shoresofthefallen.itch.io/shores-of-the-fallen
Founder's Edition ($7.99): the full island, every Early Access update, and a free Steam key at launch.
Steam page coming soon. Early Access, December 2026.

Discord: https://discord.gg/pyNTPKhQMq
Website: https://www.shoresofthefallen.com

Made by a solo developer.

#ShoresOfTheFallen #ZombieSurvival #IndieGame
